## Aim

This script reads the cleaned BrainSpan data from `02_clean.qmd` and adds two variables for the analysis: log-transformed expression and developmental age group. It also extracts numeric ages from the original age labels. The output is `data/03_dat_aug.tsv`, with one row per gene and sample.

## Loading libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Read cleaned data

The input is the long table from `02_clean.qmd`. The `rpkm` column contains the expression value, and the `age` column contains the original BrainSpan age label for each sample.

```{r}
expr_clean <- read_tsv(
  file = here("data", "02_dat_clean.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Log-transform expression

Expression values can span several orders of magnitude. We use a base-2 logarithm to compress this range. Adding 1 before taking the logarithm keeps zero expression values defined.

```{r}
expr_aug <- expr_clean |>
  mutate(log2_expr = log2(rpkm + 1))
```

## Derive developmental age and age group

We split each age label into a number and a unit. Prenatal labels such as `12 pcw` are stored in `age_pcw` as post-conception weeks. Postnatal labels such as `6 mos` and `4 yrs` are stored in `age_years`. We divide months by 12 to express both postnatal units in years.

We then assign samples to five developmental groups. Postnatal samples under 2 years are classified as Infant, ages 2 to under 12 as Child, ages 12 to under 20 as Adolescent, and ages 20 and above as Adult.

```{r}
expr_aug <- expr_aug |>
  mutate(
    age_label = str_to_lower(str_squish(age)),
    age_value = parse_number(age_label),
    age_pcw = if_else(
      str_detect(age_label, "\\bpcw$"),
      age_value,
      NA_real_
    ),
    age_years = case_when(
      str_detect(age_label, "\\bmos?$") ~ age_value / 12,
      str_detect(age_label, "\\byrs?$") ~ age_value,
      .default = NA_real_
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      !is.na(age_pcw) ~ "Prenatal",
      is.na(age_years) ~ NA_character_,
      age_years < 2 ~ "Infant",
      age_years < 12 ~ "Child",
      age_years < 20 ~ "Adolescent",
      TRUE ~ "Adult"
    ),
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("Prenatal", "Infant", "Child", "Adolescent", "Adult")
    )
  ) |>
  select(-age_label, -age_value)
```

## Check the derived ages

We show one row per distinct age label so we can check the conversions and group assignments. An age label with a missing `age_group` can be inspected in the original `age` column.

```{r}
expr_aug |>
  distinct(age, age_pcw, age_years, age_group) |>
  arrange(age_group, age_pcw, age_years)
```

## Write augmented data

```{r}
expr_aug |>
  write_tsv(file = here("data", "03_dat_aug.tsv"))
```
